discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.10.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.10/cis_2.3.10.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Domain Controller only (from the upstream task name).

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.10.6 | PATCH | Ensure Network access Named Pipes that can be accessed anonymously is configured (DC only) | Domain Controller"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_2_3_10_6
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - rule_2.3.10.6
    - patch
    - namedpipes
    - NIST800-171_3.5.3
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-2_2
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanManServer\Parameters
    name: NullSessionPipes
    data: ['LSARPC', 'NETLOGON', 'SAMR']
    type: multistring
